name: Azami Kimihito
source:
"Is it wrong to believe?"

Occupation: Butler

Even though I'm not supposed to fall in love...

He has been serving the Kanetomi family since his parents' generation. He attended regular school until elementary and then studied mainly by correspondence, while also undergoing rigorous training in manners and language. He and his identical twin brother began working together as live-in workers 4 years ago, but have been entrusted with the care of Kanetomi since he was a child. He seems like a perfect worker who responds to unreasonable demands without changing his color, but this is due to the fact that he was strictly disciplined from childhood. His serious nature makes it difficult for him to release stress, which leads to indigestion and causes clumsiness.

   His first encounter with you is when Kanetomi brings you with him. It's the first time he has ever brought a girl home, which piqued his interest in you. He is both sympathetic and admiring of his master's stouthearted behavior, and your kind behavior towards him causes him to lose his cool, even though he knows he's not supposed to fall in love.
